shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
The weather is really nice today, isn't it?
I enjoy cooking different recipes on weekends.
My favorite movie is something I can watch again.
Traveling to new places always brings me joy.
I often listen to music while I work or study.
Learning a new language can be quite challenging.
Going for a walk helps me clear my mind and relax.
I think volunteering is a great way to give back to the community.
Building strong relationships with friends and family is important for happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about dietary habits.
questions: Q1: What are some of your favorite meals to eat?
Q2: Have you ever faced any challenges maintaining a healthy diet?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to eat healthy food?
Q4: What advice would you give someone trying to improve their diet?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about leisure activities.
questions: Q1: What do you enjoy doing in your spare time?
Q2: Have you ever struggled to find time for your hobbies?
Q3: How do you think leisure activities affect our well-being?
Q4: What suggestions do you have for someone looking to start a new hobby?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about environmental awareness.
questions: Q1: What actions do you take to be environmentally friendly?
Q2: Have you encountered any difficulties in living sustainably?
Q3: What is your view on the importance of protecting the environment?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone wanting to adopt a greener lifestyle?
